Dmitri: Quick heads-up — hit a tenant OOM during a staged offload window on prod-dedicated-07. Fencing callback didn't seem to block allocations, we raced into a host allocation and then GPU eviction loop.
Eva: ugh. do you have the logs/snippets? what was the offload policy? :thinking:
Dmitri: Policy = staged (hotset-keep: 128MB, async-evict: true). Log snippet below — you can see alloc -> fence -> alloc interleaving.
```
[2026-03-18T14:02:11Z] alloc(tenant=prod-3, size=12MB) -> GPU
[2026-03-18T14:02:11Z] fence_request(tenant=prod-3, id=0x7f8a) queued
[2026-03-18T14:02:11Z] alloc(tenant=prod-3, size=8MB) -> HOST
[2026-03-18T14:02:11Z] OOM: host_reserve_exhausted tenant=prod-3
[2026-03-18T14:02:12Z] fence_complete(tenant=prod-3, id=0x7f8a)
```
Sam: looks like the fencing path only serializes on the GPU eviction critical section. if host allocations don't consult the same fence sequence number, they can slip in while the fence is pending.
Maya: can you repro with a short script? i can try toggling staged->sync-offload to see if behavior changes. if sync-offload works that's a strong signal.
Dmitri: repro script attached (super small). reproduces in ~30s on our dev-dedicated runner with tenant weight 3.
```
# repro.sh (simplified)
for i in `seq 1 200`; do
  redis-cli incr alloc && ./small_alloc --size=12M &
  sleep 0.01
done
```
OffloadBot: [ALERT] HostOOM detected on host-gpu-12 for tenant=prod-3 at 2026-03-18T14:02:11Z. Eviction loop triggered. IncidentID=offload-20260318-43
Eva: hmm. two hypotheses:
1) fence ordering bug: fence issuance and host allocator ordering diverge across threads.
2) freelist/coalesce path on host alloc bypasses the residency check.
Sam: i can take hypothesis #2. i remember a change where small host fastpath used non-blocking deposit to freelist for perf — that would skip the per-tenant fence. i'll grep for "fastpath_deposit".
Maya: if it's the fastpath we should gate it behind a per-tenant opt-in flag while we patch. quick mitigation = throttle host allocations for staged offload tenants to 1/s and raise host_reserve for them.
Dmitri: good call. can someone quickly try raising host_reserve to 512MB for prod-3 to stop production blowups while we root cause?
Sam: will open a PR to add a per-tenant fencing check into the fastpath deposit. patch idea below:
```
if (tenant_has_pending_fence(tenant)) {
  slowpath_deposit(); // consult fence seq
} else {
  fastpath_deposit();
}
```
Eva: also add a metric (fence_skipped_count) so we can see how often fastpath skipped during offload windows.
Maya: i'll run the repro against a branch with fastpath gated and sync-offload toggle. will post results in ~45m.
Dmitri: TY. i'll escalate mitigation (host_reserve bump) and open a short RFC to document allocation fencing contract between host/gpu allocators. include API: `tenant_has_pending_fence(tenant)`, `acquire_fence_guard(seq)`.
Sam: noted. i'll draft the PR and include a unit test that simulates interleaved fence+alloc. cc @Maya for integration test harness.
Maya: repro on gated-fastpath branch: PASS (no OOM after 200 runs). will run longer stress overnight and share traces.
Dmitri: perfect. next steps: 1) patch fastpath -> gated check (Sam), 2) short RFC for allocation-fence API (Dmitri), 3) mitigation rollout (increase host_reserve for prod-3) (Ops), 4) telemetry (Eva).
Sam: adding PR link shortly.
OffloadBot: [INFO] Deploy job queued: offload-fix-gated-fastpath -> staging. CI: 12/12
Dmitri: closing loop here. thanks all. we'll follow up in the RFC thread with interface sketches and perf impact numbers. :thumbsup:
